responsibility: Defines machine-description patterns for the PowerISA crypto and hash vector instructions introduced around ISA 2.07. It introduces UNSPEC codes and RTL insn patterns for vcipher/vncipher, vsbox, vshasigma, vpermxor, and vpmsum forms, allowing rs6000 builtins and vector operations gated by -mcrypto or related ISA options to lower to the correct vector crypto opcodes.
